verdict.rationale: The only evidence on access control is pricing-page bullets: 'Advanced permissioning' on Pro and 'Advanced access control' on Enterprise. Approval workflows, which require review before publishing flag changes, add a governance layer. There are no docs describing roles, per-flag or per-project permission scoping, or scoped API tokens; the SDK Connection Endpoint is only read-only payload access, not scoped management tokens. Missing for 10: documented role/permission model, per-flag or per-environment permission scoping, scoped API token docs, independent corroboration.
